detached_structure.evidence: A small gray rectangular roofed structure sits just left of the central house, and a larger gray-roofed building lies at the bottom-left, though it may belong to a neighboring lot.

signals.notes: The central house is heavily shaded and partly obscured by autumn tree canopy and dark shadows, so the roof and yard are hard to judge; a white car is parked on a neighboring driveway to the south, not on the central lot.
